summary: 정동영 통일부 장관이 미국 대사·유엔군사령관과 연쇄 회동해 소통 강화

editorial.titleTr: Chung Dong-young Faces Fresh Scrutiny as He Meets Steel, Brunson Back-to-Back Over Divisive Remarks
summaryTr: Unification Minister Jung Dong-young holds consecutive meetings with U.S. Ambassador and UN Command to strengthen communication
Korea-U.S. intelligence sharing on North Korea and DMZ jurisdiction tensions intensify following nuclear facility remarks
Timing of wartime operational control transfer requires resolving alliance distrust and strengthening coordination with UN Command
editorial.bodyTr: Unification Minister Jung Dong-young met with U.S. Ambassador to Korea Michele Steel and UN Command Chief Javier Brun on the 20th, moving to strengthen communication. Following Minister Jung's remarks on core nuclear facilities, South Korea-U.S. intelligence sharing on North Korea has been shaken, and friction over DMZ jurisdiction and the DMZ law has continued. This editorial emphasizes the need to clear away alliance distrust and strengthen pragmatic consultations with the UN Command at a time when the transition of wartime operational control is being pursued.

editorials.titleTr: College Entrance Exam Barely Salvaged Through Test-Takers and Proctors' Sacrifice... Education Minister's Removal Warranted
summaryTr: The college entrance exam concluded without major incidents through cooperation between test-takers and proctors.
111 cases of cheating involving electronic devices were detected, prompting emergency measures including disaster alert texts.
Critics called for the education minister's dismissal, citing the Education Ministry's belated preparations.
editorials.bodyTr: This year's college entrance exam concluded without major incident thanks to cooperation between test-takers and proctors. According to Education Ministry tallies, 111 cases of cheating involving electronic devices were detected, and temporary measures including emergency text alerts were mobilized. The editorial criticized the Education Ministry for delayed preparation and response, and called for the dismissal of the education minister and the establishment of a new command structure.

editorials.body: ① 대법원이 한덕수 전 국무총리 사건을 일부 무죄 취지로 파기환송하자 민주당이 조희대 대법원장 탄핵을 추진했습니다. ② 민주당은 20일 의원총회에서 탄핵을 당론으로 정하고 탄핵 추진단을 꾸렸으며 본회의 통과 시 직무가 정지됩니다. ③ 사설은 판결은 비판할 수 있어도 판결 내용만으로 탄핵하면 삼권분립이 흔들리고 같은 일이 반복될 수 있다고 지적했습니다.
summary: 민주당이 대법원 판결에 불만해 조희대 대법원장 탄핵을 추진했다.
판결 내용만으로 탄핵하면 삼권분립 원칙이 훼손된다.
같은 보복성 탄핵이 반복되는 악순환을 막아야 한다.

editorials.stance: 정치적 보복성 탄핵은 헌정질서를 위협하므로 즉시 중단해야 한다.
editorials.titleTr: Democratic Party Must Stop 'Impeachment Politics' Shaking Separation of Powers
summaryTr: The Democratic Party pushed for the impeachment of Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae in dissatisfaction with a Supreme Court ruling.
Impeaching based solely on the court's decision would undermine the principle of separation of powers.
We must prevent a vicious cycle of repeated retaliatory impeachments.
editorials.bodyTr: After the Supreme Court overturned and remanded the case of former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo with a partial acquittal ruling, the Democratic Party moved to impeach Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae. At a general meeting of party members on the 20th, the Democratic Party adopted impeachment as party policy, organized an impeachment task force, and his duties would be suspended upon passage in the plenary session. The editorial pointed out that while court rulings can be criticized, impeaching based solely on the contents of a decision would undermine the separation of powers and could lead to the same situation repeating itself.

editorial.titleTr: [Editorial] Day After Ruling, Ruling Party Rushes Impeachment of Chief Justice in Reckless Constitutional Breach
summaryTr: The Democratic Party has adopted the impeachment of Chief Justice Jo Hee-dae as an official party position.
The move cited martial law response and election law rulings as reasons, but is suspected of political motives.
Constitutional shortcomings raise concerns about undermining separation of powers and paralyzing the judiciary.
editorial.bodyTr: The Democratic Party of Korea has adopted the impeachment of Chief Justice Jo Hee-dae as party policy. The Democratic Party cited responses to martial law and the Lee Jae-myung election law ruling as grounds, but criticism has emerged that this represents politically motivated impeachment. The move, which falls short of constitutional requirements for impeachment, risks undermining the separation of powers and causing paralysis of judicial functions, observers point out.

editorial.title: [사설] AI 커닝에 흔들린 국가시험, 근본부터 바꿔야
editorial.body: 입력 업데이트 종합 38면 2026.11.21 06:00 2026.11.21 01:17 2026.11.21 00:34 인공지능(AI) 커닝 우려 속에 치러진 2027학년도 대학수학능력시험에서 전자기기 관련 부정행위 111건이 적발됐다. 이 중 시험 도중 스마트기기를 사용하다 적발된 사례도 5건이었다. 세무사 시험 수석 합격자의 AI 커닝 실토로 큰 파문이 일었고, 정부가 강력한 처벌을 경고했는데도 이런 일이 벌어졌다. 세무사 시험의 부정행위가 드러나지 않았다면 과연 얼마나 많은 커닝이 시도됐을까. 이 위험은 수능이 끝났다고 사라지는 것이 아니다. 대학별 논술·면접전형이 이어지는 만큼 각 대학은 첨단기기를 악용한 부정행위에 철저히 대비해야 한다. 교육부도 관련 정보를 공유하고 장비와 감독 인력 확보를 적극 지원해야 할 것이다. 이번 AI 커닝 사태는 국가의 시험 관리 역량에 의문을 던지는 동시에 AI 시대에 걸맞은 인재 평가·양성 체계의 필요성을 일깨웠다. AI 커닝의 위험은 이미 여러 국가자격시험에서 현실로 나타났다. 올해 소방설비기사와 공인중개사, 건축기사 등에서 스마트안경 관련 부정행위가 12건 적발됐고, 감독관의 확인 요구를 거부하고 시험장을 이탈한 응시자도 있었다. 그런데도 교육부는 수능 직전에야 허둥지둥 대책을 마련했다. 국가자격시험을 관리하는 관계 부처와 한국산업인력공단 등의 대응에 문제가 없었는지 철저히 따져야 한다. 잇따른 위험 신호가 왜 국가 차원의 선제적 대응으로 이어지지 못했는지를 명확히 규명하고, 최교진 교육부 장관을 비롯한 당국자들에게도 책임을 엄하게 물어야 할 것이다. 대학수학능력시험(수능)을 이틀 앞둔 17일 서울 시내의 한 카메라 매장에 '초소형 카메라' 등 문구가 붙어져 있다. 한성숙 국무총리는 이날 열린 국무회의에서 수능 부정행위 우려가 높아지는 것과 관련해 ″스마트폰 등 모든 스마트기기는 전원 종료 후 수거하고 수험생이 착용한 안경과 시계를 전수 점검하겠다″고 말했다. 뉴스1 아울러 국가가 직접 시행하거나 다른 기관에 위탁한 각종 시험의 관리체계 전반을 대수술해야 한다. 그동안 정부가 첨단기술의 발전에 맞춰 시험의 공정성과 신뢰를 어떻게 지킬 것인지 근본적으로 고민한 흔적은 찾아보기 어렵다. 뒤늦게 고용노동부는 전파탐지기 도입과 전문 감독관 육성, 이상 점수 분석 등을 추진하기로 했다. 대책의 실효성을 검증하면서 부정행위 수법과 대응 기술을 상시 연구·공유하는 범정부적 관리체계를 구축해야 한다. 세계 각국의 대응을 면밀히 살피고 AI 기업의 협력도 이끌어낼 필요가 있다. 이를 통해 무너진 국가시험의 신뢰를 회복해야 한다. 세무사 시험의 부정행위가 드러나면서 여러 전문자격시험의 공정성까지 의심받고 있다. 정당하게 자격을 취득한 합격자들이 의심받는 상황을 방치해서는 안 된다. 한국세무사회는 불신 해소를 위해 수습 실무교육에서 AI를 차단한 주관식 평가를 도입하기로 했다. 이처럼 시험 이후에도 전문적 능력을 객관적으로 확인하는 체계를 강화해야 한다. 더 근본적인 과제는 AI 시대에 필요한 인재를 어떻게 길러내고 평가할 것인지에 있다. AI에 이번 수능의 국어·영어·수학 문제를 풀게 했더니 10분 안팎에 세 과목 모두 만점을 받은 모델도 있었다. AI의 성능은 앞으로 더욱 발전할 것이다. 기초 지식과 사고력을 평가하는 시험은 여전히 필요하지만, AI 사용을 금지한 채 기존 방식으로 인재를 평가하는 것이 과연 최선인지 의문이 들 수밖에 없다. 학교 교육부터 대학입시와 전문자격시험에 이르기까지 근본적인 재검토가 필요한 시점이다. 이재명 정부는 AI 3대 강국을 국가적 목표로 내세우고 있다. 그러나 AI 모델을 개발하고 데이터센터를 확충하는 것만으로 그 목표를 이룰 수는 없다. 기술을 창의적으로 활용할 인재를 길러내고 그 역량을 제대로 평가하는 제도적 기반도 갖춰야 한다. 이번 사태를 일회성 사건으로 넘기지 말고 정부와 정치권, 교육계와 기업, 시민사회가 함께 새로운 인재 양성·선발 체계를 논의하는 계기로 삼아야 한다. 나라의 미래를 다시 설계한다는 각오로 우리 사회가 대개혁에 나서야 할 때다.
editorial.pullQuote: AI 사용을 금지한 채 기존 방식으로 인재를 평가하는 것이 과연 최선인지 의문이 들 수밖에 없다.
summary: 수능에서 AI 커닝 111건 적발, 세무사 시험 파문 이후에도 부정행위 계속되고 있다.
정부는 첨단기술 발전에 대비하지 못했고, 범정부적 관리체계 구축이 긴급하다.
AI 시대 인재평가 체계 근본 개편이 필요하며, 금지만으로는 한계가 명확하다.
editorial.stance: AI 커닝은 증상일 뿐, 근본 원인은 AI 시대에 맞지 않는 평가체계이므로 대사회적 개혁이 필요하다.
editorial.titleTr: Editorial: Nation's Exams Rocked by AI Cheating, Need Fundamental Overhaul
summaryTr: 111 cases of AI cheating detected on the college entrance exam, with misconduct continuing even after the tax accountant exam scandal.
The government failed to prepare for advances in cutting-edge technology, and establishing a government-wide management system is urgent.
A fundamental overhaul of talent evaluation systems for the AI era is necessary, and prohibition alone has clear limitations.
editorial.bodyTr: One hundred and eleven cases of cheating involving electronic devices were detected during the 2027 College Scholastic Ability Test, which was administered amid concerns over artificial intelligence cheating. Among these, five cases involved the use of smart devices during the exam itself. The incident caused a major uproar when a top-ranked passer in the tax accountant examination admitted to AI cheating, and occurred despite the government's warnings of severe punishment. Had the misconduct in the tax accountant exam gone undetected, one can only wonder how many more attempts at cheating might have occurred. This risk does not disappear once the college entrance exam ends. With essay and interview selections by individual universities to follow, each institution must thoroughly prepare for cheating involving advanced technology. The Ministry of Education must actively support the sharing of relevant information and the securing of equipment and supervisory personnel. The AI cheating scandal has raised questions about the state's capacity to manage national exams while highlighting the need for a talent evaluation and development system befitting the AI era. The risks of AI cheating have already become reality across several national qualification exams. This year, twelve cases of cheating involving smart glasses were detected in the fire protection engineer, certified real estate agent, and architectural engineer examinations, with some test takers even refusing to comply with invigilators and leaving the exam hall. Yet the Ministry of Education hastily prepared countermeasures only days before the college entrance exam. The relevant government departments managing national qualification exams and organizations such as the Korea Human Resources Development Service must be thoroughly held accountable for their response failures. It must be clearly determined why successive warning signs failed to trigger preemptive responses at the national level, and responsibility must be strictly demanded of officials including Education Minister Choi Kyou-jin. Beyond this, the entire management system for various tests directly administered by the state or delegated to other institutions must undergo major overhaul. It is difficult to find evidence that the government has fundamentally considered how to maintain the fairness and credibility of exams in keeping with advances in cutting-edge technology. Belatedly, the Ministry of Employment and Labor decided to pursue the introduction of radio wave detection equipment, cultivation of specialized invigilators, and analysis of anomalous scores. While verifying the effectiveness of these measures, an inter-agency management system must be established to continuously research and share cheating methods and countermeasures. The country must carefully examine responses from nations worldwide and draw cooperation from AI companies. Through these efforts, the eroded trust in national examinations must be restored. As misconduct in the tax accountant exam came to light, the fairness of multiple professional qualification exams has fallen under suspicion. The situation cannot be allowed to persist where those who legitimately obtained qualifications are viewed with doubt. The Korean Tax Accountant Association decided to introduce subjective evaluation screening out AI in apprenticeship training to dispel distrust. Similarly, systems must be strengthened to objectively verify professional competence even after exams are completed. The more fundamental challenge lies in how to cultivate and evaluate talent needed in the age of AI. When AI was given this year's college entrance exam questions in Korean, English, and mathematics, some models received perfect scores in all three subjects in around ten minutes. AI performance will continue to advance further. While tests evaluating foundational knowledge and critical thinking remain necessary, one cannot help but question whether evaluating talent through existing methods while banning AI use represents the best approach. A fundamental reexamination is needed from school education through university admissions and professional qualification exams. The Lee Jae-myung administration has set becoming one of the world's three AI superpowers as a national goal. However, this objective cannot be achieved merely by developing AI models and expanding data centers. An institutional foundation must also be established to cultivate talent capable of creatively utilizing technology and to properly evaluate such capabilities. This incident must not be treated as a one-time occurrence but rather as an opportunity for the government, political circles, educational institutions, businesses, and civil society to jointly discuss a new talent development and selection system. It is time for our society to undertake major reform with the resolve to redesign the nation's future.

AI 커닝의 위험은 이미 여러 국가자격시험에서 현실로 나타났다. 올해 소방설비기사와 공인중개사, 건축기사 등에서 스마트안경 관련 부정행위가 12건 적발됐고, 감독관의 확인 요구를 거부하고 시험장을 이탈한 응시자도 있었다. 그런데도 교육부는 수능 직전에야 허둥지둥 대책을 마련했다. 국가자격시험을 관리하는 관계 부처와 한국산업인력공단 등의 대응에 문제가 없었는지 철저히 따져야 한다. 잇따른 위험 신호가 왜 국가 차원의 선제적 대응으로 이어지지 못했는지를 명확히 규명하고, 최교진 교육부 장관을 비롯한 당국자들에게도 책임을 엄하게 물어야 할 것이다. 대학수학능력시험(수능)을 이틀 앞둔 17일 서울 시내의 한 카메라 매장에 '초소형 카메라' 등 문구가 붙어져 있다. 한성숙 국무총리는 이날 열린 국무회의에서 수능 부정행위 우려가 높아지는 것과 관련해 ″스마트폰 등 모든 스마트기기는 전원 종료 후 수거하고 수험생이 착용한 안경과 시계를 전수 점검하겠다″고 말했다. 뉴스1 아울러 국가가 직접 시행하거나 다른 기관에 위탁한 각종 시험의 관리체계 전반을 대수술해야 한다. 그동안 정부가 첨단기술의 발전에 맞춰 시험의 공정성과 신뢰를 어떻게 지킬 것인지 근본적으로 고민한 흔적은 찾아보기 어렵다. 뒤늦게 고용노동부는 전파탐지기 도입과 전문 감독관 육성, 이상 점수 분석 등을 추진하기로 했다. 대책의 실효성을 검증하면서 부정행위 수법과 대응 기술을 상시 연구·공유하는 범정부적 관리체계를 구축해야 한다. 세계 각국의 대응을 면밀히 살피고 AI 기업의 협력도 이끌어낼 필요가 있다. 이를 통해 무너진 국가시험의 신뢰를 회복해야 한다. 세무사 시험의 부정행위가 드러나면서 여러 전문자격시험의 공정성까지 의심받고 있다. 정당하게 자격을 취득한 합격자들이 의심받는 상황을 방치해서는 안 된다. 한국세무사회는 불신 해소를 위해 수습 실무교육에서 AI를 차단한 주관식 평가를 도입하기로 했다. 이처럼 시험 이후에도 전문적 능력을 객관적으로 확인하는 체계를 강화해야 한다. 더 근본적인 과제는 AI 시대에 필요한 인재를 어떻게 길러내고 평가할 것인지에 있다. AI에 이번 수능의 국어·영어·수학 문제를 풀게 했더니 10분 안팎에 세 과목 모두 만점을 받은 모델도 있었다. AI의 성능은 앞으로 더욱 발전할 것이다. 기초 지식과 사고력을 평가하는 시험은 여전히 필요하지만, AI 사용을 금지한 채 기존 방식으로 인재를 평가하는 것이 과연 최선인지 의문이 들 수밖에 없다. 학교 교육부터 대학입시와 전문자격시험에 이르기까지 근본적인 재검토가 필요한 시점이다. 이재명 정부는 AI 3대 강국을 국가적 목표로 내세우고 있다. 그러나 AI 모델을 개발하고 데이터센터를 확충하는 것만으로 그 목표를 이룰 수는 없다. 기술을 창의적으로 활용할 인재를 길러내고 그 역량을 제대로 평가하는 제도적 기반도 갖춰야 한다. 이번 사태를 일회성 사건으로 넘기지 말고 정부와 정치권, 교육계와 기업, 시민사회가 함께 새로운 인재 양성·선발 체계를 논의하는 계기로 삼아야 한다. 나라의 미래를 다시 설계한다는 각오로 우리 사회가 대개혁에 나서야 할 때다.
editorials.pullQuote: AI 사용을 금지한 채 기존 방식으로 인재를 평가하는 것이 과연 최선인지 의문이 들 수밖에 없다.
summary: 수능에서 AI 커닝 111건 적발, 세무사 시험 파문 이후에도 부정행위 계속되고 있다.
정부는 첨단기술 발전에 대비하지 못했고, 범정부적 관리체계 구축이 긴급하다.
AI 시대 인재평가 체계 근본 개편이 필요하며, 금지만으로는 한계가 명확하다.
editorials.stance: AI 커닝은 증상일 뿐, 근본 원인은 AI 시대에 맞지 않는 평가체계이므로 대사회적 개혁이 필요하다.
editorials.titleTr: Editorial: Nation's Exams Rocked by AI Cheating, Need Fundamental Overhaul
summaryTr: 111 cases of AI cheating detected on the college entrance exam, with misconduct continuing even after the tax accountant exam scandal.
The government failed to prepare for advances in cutting-edge technology, and establishing a government-wide management system is urgent.
A fundamental overhaul of talent evaluation systems for the AI era is necessary, and prohibition alone has clear limitations.
editorials.bodyTr: One hundred and eleven cases of cheating involving electronic devices were detected during the 2027 College Scholastic Ability Test, which was administered amid concerns over artificial intelligence cheating. Among these, five cases involved the use of smart devices during the exam itself. The incident caused a major uproar when a top-ranked passer in the tax accountant examination admitted to AI cheating, and occurred despite the government's warnings of severe punishment. Had the misconduct in the tax accountant exam gone undetected, one can only wonder how many more attempts at cheating might have occurred. This risk does not disappear once the college entrance exam ends. With essay and interview selections by individual universities to follow, each institution must thoroughly prepare for cheating involving advanced technology. The Ministry of Education must actively support the sharing of relevant information and the securing of equipment and supervisory personnel. The AI cheating scandal has raised questions about the state's capacity to manage national exams while highlighting the need for a talent evaluation and development system befitting the AI era. The risks of AI cheating have already become reality across several national qualification exams. This year, twelve cases of cheating involving smart glasses were detected in the fire protection engineer, certified real estate agent, and architectural engineer examinations, with some test takers even refusing to comply with invigilators and leaving the exam hall. Yet the Ministry of Education hastily prepared countermeasures only days before the college entrance exam. The relevant government departments managing national qualification exams and organizations such as the Korea Human Resources Development Service must be thoroughly held accountable for their response failures. It must be clearly determined why successive warning signs failed to trigger preemptive responses at the national level, and responsibility must be strictly demanded of officials including Education Minister Choi Kyou-jin. Beyond this, the entire management system for various tests directly administered by the state or delegated to other institutions must undergo major overhaul. It is difficult to find evidence that the government has fundamentally considered how to maintain the fairness and credibility of exams in keeping with advances in cutting-edge technology. Belatedly, the Ministry of Employment and Labor decided to pursue the introduction of radio wave detection equipment, cultivation of specialized invigilators, and analysis of anomalous scores. While verifying the effectiveness of these measures, an inter-agency management system must be established to continuously research and share cheating methods and countermeasures. The country must carefully examine responses from nations worldwide and draw cooperation from AI companies. Through these efforts, the eroded trust in national examinations must be restored. As misconduct in the tax accountant exam came to light, the fairness of multiple professional qualification exams has fallen under suspicion. The situation cannot be allowed to persist where those who legitimately obtained qualifications are viewed with doubt. The Korean Tax Accountant Association decided to introduce subjective evaluation screening out AI in apprenticeship training to dispel distrust. Similarly, systems must be strengthened to objectively verify professional competence even after exams are completed. The more fundamental challenge lies in how to cultivate and evaluate talent needed in the age of AI. When AI was given this year's college entrance exam questions in Korean, English, and mathematics, some models received perfect scores in all three subjects in around ten minutes. AI performance will continue to advance further. While tests evaluating foundational knowledge and critical thinking remain necessary, one cannot help but question whether evaluating talent through existing methods while banning AI use represents the best approach. A fundamental reexamination is needed from school education through university admissions and professional qualification exams. The Lee Jae-myung administration has set becoming one of the world's three AI superpowers as a national goal. However, this objective cannot be achieved merely by developing AI models and expanding data centers. An institutional foundation must also be established to cultivate talent capable of creatively utilizing technology and to properly evaluate such capabilities. This incident must not be treated as a one-time occurrence but rather as an opportunity for the government, political circles, educational institutions, businesses, and civil society to jointly discuss a new talent development and selection system. It is time for our society to undertake major reform with the resolve to redesign the nation's future.

editorial.title: The credibility test
editorial.body: Emergency alerts and hasty checks cannot repair outdated state examination systems A test can survive a noisy morning and still fail a test of public confidence. South Korea’s College Scholastic Ability Test, held Thursday, put that distinction on display. Some 552,000 applicants faced extraordinary anti-cheating measures at 1,312 test centers: Three nationwide emergency text alerts that triggered loud alarms even on muted phones, inspections of eyeglasses and stickers placed over clothing buttons. Flights, public transport and stock-market hours were adjusted around the exam. Such coordination reflects the CSAT’s influence over young people's futures. It makes the failure to prepare for a foreseeable threat harder to excuse. The initial trigger was the disclosure that this year’s top scorer on the certified tax accountant exam had used generative artificial intelligence, a miniature camera and an earpiece. He reportedly evaded supervisors on other state exams. Warnings had accumulated. Smart glasses had appeared in school assessments and university admissions tests, and a lawmaker demonstrated their cheating potential at an Education Ministry audit on Oct. 7. Authorities had ample time to prepare before a national examination became an emergency. Instead, the final days brought improvised controls. Supervisors were told to inspect glasses and seal buttons; the government proposed a 10-year ban for offenders and rewards of up to 100 million won ($75,000) for informants. The first alert found 22 smartphones that had not been handed in. Officials reported no advanced-device cases among those found. That confirms the alert found phones, not whether miniature cameras or earpieces escaped detection. Around 8,400 additional personnel were deployed after brief training. Some students switched from glasses to contact lenses or removed buttons to avoid scrutiny. Sudden alarms can break concentration, while time extensions after investigations may differ across rooms. Informant rewards may encourage vigilance, but they can also turn candidates into amateur investigators. Fairness depends on consistent conditions. A growing tally of inspections cannot guarantee them. Visual checks are poorly matched to devices designed to go undetected. Cameras can be hidden in ordinary objects and earpieces made tiny. Overseas sellers already market such equipment. China's university entrance exam this June combined multiple screening stages with signal jammers and electronic monitoring. Chinese AI providers also suspended image-based problem-solving services during the test. Seoul should study this coordination, but the radio-wave laws restrict interference with legitimate communications. Detection and signal controls need clear legal authority and narrow boundaries. Officials who ignored repeated warnings must answer for the failure. Personnel changes and detector purchases, however, will not resolve the underlying weakness. The government should update rules on wireless interference, equip test centers appropriately and cooperate with major AI providers. These measures demand planning and testing well before the next exam. Government agencies and professional bodies administer exams that qualify people to practice law, accounting, taxation and other professions. Many still test the command of information under controlled conditions. That premise is weakening. A study in Nature Human Behaviour found management consultants using AI scored 86 percent of the benchmark set by data scientists on a coding task, against 37 percent without AI. A post-experiment test without AI found no evidence of a gain in technical knowledge. Professional assessments should test whether candidates can question AI-generated outputs, identify errors and accept responsibility for decisions. The CSAT, too, needs a deeper debate about assessment design, though university admissions serve different purposes and operate under different constraints. Korea has long treated examination fairness as a national concern. It must now reconsider what fairness means when candidates can use smart glasses, button cameras and miniature earpieces to obtain answers. Public confidence will depend on modernizing the examination system. More alarms cannot make an outdated test fair. summaryTr: 한국의 수능은 긴급 경보를 배포하고 임시방편의 부정행위 방지 조치를 취했지만, 급조된 대책으로는 체계적 허점을 해결할 수 없다.
당국은 시험 전 스마트 안경과 은폐 장치에 관한 반복된 경고를 무시했다가 시험 직전 급하게 검사에 나섰다.
정부는 법을 개정하고, 시험 센터에 적절한 장비를 갖추며, 암기된 정보보다는 비판적 사고력을 평가하도록 평가 방식을 재설계해야 한다.
editorial.bodyTr:
긴급 경보와 급급한 단속으로는 시대에 뒤떨어진 국가시험 체계를 고칠 수 없다

시험은 시끄러운 아침을 견뎌낼 수 있지만 국민 신뢰도 검사에는 떨어질 수 있다. 지난 목요일 치러진 한국의 대학수학능력시험이 이를 여실히 보여주었다. 약 55만 2000명의 응시자들이 1312개 고사장에서 특이한 부정행위 방지 조치를 마주했다. 전국 긴급 문자 경보 3차례로 무음 상태인 휴대폰에서도 큰 알람이 울렸으며, 안경 검사와 옷 단추에 봉인 스티커가 붙여졌다. 비행기, 대중교통, 증권거래소 운영 시간이 시험에 맞춰 조정되었다. 이러한 조율은 수능이 젊은이들의 미래에 미치는 영향력을 반영한다. 예측 가능한 위협에 대해 준비하지 못한 것을 변명하기 더욱 어렵게 만든다.

초반 발단은 올해 공인회계사 시험 최고점자가 생성형 인공지능, 초소형 카메라, 무선 이어피스를 사용했다는 사실이 드러나면서 비롯되었다. 그는 다른 국가시험에서도 감시자를 피한 것으로 알려졌다. 경고는 계속 쌓여왔다. 스마트 안경이 학교 평가와 대학 입시에 나타났으며, 한 의원이 10월 7일 교육부 국감에서 그 부정행위 가능성을 시연했다. 국가시험이 긴급 사태가 되기 전에 당국은 충분히 준비할 시간이 있었다. 대신 마지막 며칠간 임시방편 조치들이 나왔다. 감시자들에게 안경과 단추를 검사하고 봉인하라는 지시가 내려졌으며, 정부는 위반자에게 10년 금지 처벌과 고발자에게 최대 1억 원의 보상금을 제안했다. 첫 경보로 55만 2000명 중 22개의 미제출 휴대폰을 적발했다. 관계자들은 발견된 기기 중 고급 장치의 사건을 보도하지 않았다. 이는 경보가 휴대폰을 적발했는지는 확인했지만, 초소형 카메라나 이어피스가 적발을 피했는지는 알 수 없다는 뜻이다. 약 8400명의 추가 인력이 간단한 훈련 후 배치되었다. 일부 수험생들은 안경에서 콘택트렌즈로 바꾸거나 단추를 제거해 단속을 피했다. 갑작스러운 경보는 집중력을 방해할 수 있으며, 조사 후 시간 연장이 호실마다 다를 수 있다. 고발 보상금은 경각심을 높일 수 있지만, 응시생들이 아마추어 조사관이 되도록 부추길 수도 있다. 공정성은 일관된 조건에 달려 있다. 늘어나는 단속만으로는 이를 보장할 수 없다. 육안 검사는 적발되지 않도록 설계된 기기와는 형편없이 맞지 않는다. 카메라는 일상용품에 숨길 수 있고 이어피스는 아주 작게 만들 수 있다. 해외 판매자들은 이미 이러한 장비를 판매하고 있다.

editorials.title: The credibility test
editorials.body: Emergency alerts and hasty checks cannot repair outdated state examination systems A test can survive a noisy morning and still fail a test of public confidence. South Korea’s College Scholastic Ability Test, held Thursday, put that distinction on display. Some 552,000 applicants faced extraordinary anti-cheating measures at 1,312 test centers: Three nationwide emergency text alerts that triggered loud alarms even on muted phones, inspections of eyeglasses and stickers placed over clothing buttons. Flights, public transport and stock-market hours were adjusted around the exam. Such coordination reflects the CSAT’s influence over young people's futures. It makes the failure to prepare for a foreseeable threat harder to excuse. The initial trigger was the disclosure that this year’s top scorer on the certified tax accountant exam had used generative artificial intelligence, a miniature camera and an earpiece. He reportedly evaded supervisors on other state exams. Warnings had accumulated. Smart glasses had appeared in school assessments and university admissions tests, and a lawmaker demonstrated their cheating potential at an Education Ministry audit on Oct. 7. Authorities had ample time to prepare before a national examination became an emergency. Instead, the final days brought improvised controls. Supervisors were told to inspect glasses and seal buttons; the government proposed a 10-year ban for offenders and rewards of up to 100 million won ($75,000) for informants. The first alert found 22 smartphones that had not been handed in. Officials reported no advanced-device cases among those found. That confirms the alert found phones, not whether miniature cameras or earpieces escaped detection. Around 8,400 additional personnel were deployed after brief training. Some students switched from glasses to contact lenses or removed buttons to avoid scrutiny. Sudden alarms can break concentration, while time extensions after investigations may differ across rooms. Informant rewards may encourage vigilance, but they can also turn candidates into amateur investigators. Fairness depends on consistent conditions. A growing tally of inspections cannot guarantee them. Visual checks are poorly matched to devices designed to go undetected. Cameras can be hidden in ordinary objects and earpieces made tiny. Overseas sellers already market such equipment. China's university entrance exam this June combined multiple screening stages with signal jammers and electronic monitoring. Chinese AI providers also suspended image-based problem-solving services during the test. Seoul should study this coordination, but the radio-wave laws restrict interference with legitimate communications. Detection and signal controls need clear legal authority and narrow boundaries. Officials who ignored repeated warnings must answer for the failure. Personnel changes and detector purchases, however, will not resolve the underlying weakness. The government should update rules on wireless interference, equip test centers appropriately and cooperate with major AI providers. These measures demand planning and testing well before the next exam. Government agencies and professional bodies administer exams that qualify people to practice law, accounting, taxation and other professions. Many still test the command of information under controlled conditions. That premise is weakening. A study in Nature Human Behaviour found management consultants using AI scored 86 percent of the benchmark set by data scientists on a coding task, against 37 percent without AI. A post-experiment test without AI found no evidence of a gain in technical knowledge. Professional assessments should test whether candidates can question AI-generated outputs, identify errors and accept responsibility for decisions. The CSAT, too, needs a deeper debate about assessment design, though university admissions serve different purposes and operate under different constraints. Korea has long treated examination fairness as a national concern. It must now reconsider what fairness means when candidates can use smart glasses, button cameras and miniature earpieces to obtain answers. Public confidence will depend on modernizing the examination system. More alarms cannot make an outdated test fair. editorials.pullQuote: 앤트로픽의 상장 뉴스도 증시 약세 흐름을 꺾지 못했다는 점에서 시장의 냉정함을 읽을 수 있다.
summary: 앤트로픽 상장에도 불구하고 증시가 급락했다.
AI 호재만으로는 시장 약세를 막을 수 없었다.
투자자들은 냉정한 시장 분석이 필요하다.
editorials.stance: AI 기업 상장 같은 긍정적 뉴스에도 불구하고 시장 흐름을 객관적으로 판단해야 한다는 주장
editorials.titleTr: Editorial: Market Plunges Despite Anthropic IPO…Time for Sober Market Assessment
summaryTr: The stock market plummeted despite Anthropic's listing.
AI tailwinds alone could not stem market weakness.
Investors need a sober market analysis.

leanScore.label: Center
leanScore.rationale: 사설이 시장 낙관과 비관 어느 한쪽을 명확히 비판하지 않고 '냉정한 분석' 필요성만 중립적으로 주장하며, 진보/보수 정책적 입장이 드러나지 않음.
